PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN) SCHEME
OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES
1.
Scheme
With a view to provide income support to all landholding farmers’ families in the country,
having cultivable land, the Central Government has implemented a Central Sector
Scheme, namely, “Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)”.
2.
Objective and Benefits
The scheme aims to supplement the financial needs of all landholding farmers’ families
in procuring various inputs to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields,
commensurate with the anticipated farm income as well as for domestic needs. Under
the Scheme an amount of Rs.6000/- per year is released by the Central Government
online directly into the bank accounts of the eligible farmers under Direct Benefit
Transfer mode, subject to certain exclusions.
3.
Definition of farmer’s family
A landholder farmer’s family is defined as “a family comprising of husband, wife
and minor children who owns cultivable land as per land records of the conce

clusions.
3.
Definition of farmer’s family
A landholder farmer’s family is defined as “a family comprising of husband, wife
and minor children who owns cultivable land as per land records of the concerned
State/UT”. The existing land-ownership system will be used for identification of
beneficiaries for calculation of benefit.
4
Exclusions
4.1
The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall not be
eligible for benefit under the scheme:
(a)
All Institutional Land holders; and
(b)
Farmer families in which one or more of its members belong to following
categories :
i) Former and present holders of constitutional posts
ii) Former and present Ministers / State Ministers and former / present Members of
Lok Sabha / Rajya Sabha / State Legislative Assemblies / State Legislative
Councils, former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations, former and
present Chairpersons of District Panchayats.
iii) All serving or retired officers and employees of Central / State Gover

ative
Councils, former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations, former and
present Chairpersons of District Panchayats.
iii) All serving or retired officers and employees of Central / State Government
Ministries / Offices / Departments and their field units, Central or State PSEs and
Attached offices / Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular

3
employees of the Local Bodies (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group
D employees)
iv) All superannuated / retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs.10,000/- or
more (Excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees)
v) All Persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.
vi) Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and
Architects registered with Professional bodies and carrying out profession by
undertaking practices.
(c) In case of new beneficiaries being uploaded on the PM-KISAN Portal, all land
holding farmers’ families who are Non-resident Indians (NRIs) in terms of the provisions
of the Income Tax Act, 1961 shall be excluded from any benefit under the Scheme.
4.2
For the purpose of exclusion State / UT Governments can certify the eligibility of
the beneficiaries based on self declaration by the beneficiaries. In case beneficiary is
not available / does not reside in the village, State / UT Governments may consider

certification based on the declaration by other adult member of his / her family. In case
of incorrect self declaration, beneficiary shall be liable for recovery of transferred
financial benefit and other penal actions as per law.
5. Methodology for calculation of benefit
5.1
The benefit shall be paid to only those farmers’ families whose names are
entered into the land records. Exception has, however, been made for North-East
States and Jharkhand in this regard.
5.2
The cut-off date for determination of eligibility of beneficiaries under the scheme
shall be 01.02.2019 and no changes thereafter shall be considered for eligibility of
benefit under the scheme for next 5 years. However, this date is not applicable when
transfer of ownership of cultivable land takes place on account of succession

5.3
Benefit will be allowed in those cases where transfer of ownership of cultivable
land takes place on account of succession due to death of the landowner. However,
those eligible farmers whose names have been entered in the land record after
01.12.2018 till 01.02.2019 shall be eligible for the benefits from the date of entry of land
rights in the land records. In such cases where, transfer of ownership of cultivable land
has happened due to any reason which could be purchase, succession, will, gift, etc.,
between 01.12.2018 and 31.01.2019, the installment pertaining to the 4-monthly period
/ trimester December, 2018 - March, 2019 during the financial year (2018-19) shall be
proportionate amount from date of transfer till 31.03.2019 with respect to the 4 months
period.

succession on account of the death of land owners before 01.12.2018, such updation of
land records may be done by the States in a time bound manner. The successors

such a transfer.

iv)

5.4
The beneficiaries, whose names are uploaded on PM-Kisan Portal by the State /
UT Government in a particular 4-month period / trimester, shall be entitled to receive
benefit for that trimester and for further installments pertaining to the subsequent
trimesters for that financial year.

In some of the North Eastern States, the land ownership rights are community

All the exclusions under the Operational Guidelines will be applicable.”

6.
Strategy for Implementation
6.1
The States shall prepare database of eligible beneficiary land holder farmer
families in the villages capturing the Name, Age, Gender, Category (SC/ST), Aadhaar
Number, Bank Account Number and the Mobile Number of the beneficiaries.
Responsibility of identifying the land holder farmer family eligible for benefit under the
scheme shall be of the State / UT Government. In case of beneficiaries in States of
Assam, Meghalaya, J&K where Aadhaar number has not been issued to most of the
citizens, Aadhaar number shall be collected for those beneficiaries where it is available
and for others alternate prescribed documents such as Driving Licence, Voters’ ID Card,
NREGA Job Card, or any other identification documents i

and for others alternate prescribed documents such as Driving Licence, Voters’ ID Card,
NREGA Job Card, or any other identification documents issued by Central / State / UT
Governments or their authorities, etc. can be collected for identity verification purposes.
These three States have been exempted from the requirement of Aadhaar number till
31.3.2021. In the meantime these States will complete Aadhaar enrolment. States / UTs
shall ensure that there is no duplication of the payment transferred to eligible families.
Speedy reconciliation in case of wrong / incomplete bank details of the beneficiary
should be ensured.
6.2
For the purpose of exclusion States have to take a self-declaration from the
beneficiaries as detailed in par 4.2 above. In the said self-declaration taken by the
States / UT Governments an undertaking should also be included wherein the consent
of the beneficiaries should be taken for using the Aadhaar number

Union Territory Administration can use the beneficiary Aadhaar number and other
information provided in the declaration to verify the eligibility of the beneficiary for
scheme as per extant scheme guidelines with the concerned agencies”.
6.3
The existing land-ownership system in the concerned State / UT will be used for
identification of beneficiaries. Accordingly, it is of utmost importance that the land
records are clear and updated. Further, State / UT Governments would also expedite

the progress of digitization of the land records and linking the same with Aadhaar as
well as bank details of the beneficiaries.
6.4
The lists of eligible beneficiaries would be published at the village level. Farmers’
families who are eligible but have been excluded should be provided an opportunity to
represent their case.
7.
Review, Monitoring and Grievance Redressal Mechanism
7.1
There will be stratified review / monitoring mechanism at National, State and
District Level. At the National level, the Review Committee will be headed by Cabinet
Secretary. The States shall notify the State and District Level Review / Monitoring
Committee.
7.2
The States shall also notify State and District Level Grievance Redressal
Monitoring Committees for looking into all the grievances related to implementation of
the scheme. Any grievances or complaints which are received should be disposed off
on merit preferably within two weeks time.

8.
Setting up of Project Monitoring Unit (PMU)
8.1
A Project Monitoring Unit (PMU) at Central level will be set up in the Department
of Agriculture, Cooperation & Farmers Welfare (DAC&FW) in the form of a Society
registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860. This PMU shall be tasked with
the responsibility of overall monitoring of the scheme and shall be headed by Chief
Executive Officer (CEO). PMU shall also undertake publicity campaign (Information,
Education and Communication-IEC).
8.2
Each State / UT Government will designate a Nodal Department for
implementation of the scheme and coordinating with Central Government with regard to
implementation of Income Support Scheme.
8.3
On the lines of PMU at central level, States / UTs may consider setting up
dedicated Project Monitoring Units at State / UT Level. 0.125% for the amount of

State / UT Government to cover the expenditure on their PMUs, if established and for
meeting other related administrative expenses including cost to be incurred for
procurement of stationary, field verification, filling of prescribed formats, their
certification and its uploading as well as incentive for field functionaries, publicity, etc.
States / UTs will furnish the details of the account to which Administrative Charges are
credited by the Central Government. The administrative charges payable to the States /
UTs will be provided by Government of India based on the volume of work and the
number of beneficiaries.

9.
PM-Kisan Portal for implementation of the scheme (Beneficiary Details
uploading by State)
9.1
Beneficiaries under the scheme are to be identified by the respective State and
Union Territory. The details of farmers are being maintained by the States / UTs either
in electronic form or in manual register. To make integrated platform available in the
country to assist in benefit transfer, a platform named PM-Kisan Portal available at
URL (http://pmkisan.gov.in) has been be launched for uploading the farmers’ details
at a single web-portal in a uniform structure.
9.2
The PM-Kisan Portal has been created with the following objectives -
i)
To provide verified and single source of truth on farmers’ details at the portal.
ii)
Timely assistance to the farmers in farm operation
iii)
A unified e-platform for transferring of cash benefits into farmer’s bank account
through Public Financial Management System (PFMS) integration.
iv)
Location wise availability of benefited farmers’ list.
v)
Ease

platform for transferring of cash benefits into farmer’s bank account
through Public Financial Management System (PFMS) integration.
iv)
Location wise availability of benefited farmers’ list.
v)
Ease of monitoring across the country on fund transaction details.

with any other ID proof like Voter ID etc, Gender, Category, IFSC Code, Bank
Account Number.
Farmer Attributes (Optional):
Father name, Address, Mobile Number, Date of Birth/Age, Farm-Size in Hectare,
Survey Number, Khasra Number
Optional attributes such as Mobile number can be utilized for SMS alerts. Other
optional attributes may be used for purpose of future requirement. However,
these attributes are not essential for purpose of transfer of money.

9.4
There are 3 ways through which a State / UT can onboard on the PM Kisan
Portal:
(a)
If a State / UT has village / district wise list of farmers, they may upload
the same in a pre-defined format and with the help of local NIC State Unit.
(b)
Some existing data of farmers is already available on the PM-Kisan Portal
which will be visible on selection of States / Districts / Village. States / UTs
which do not have their own list may use this village-wise list of farmers as
provided on the portal and edit the same to finalize the farmers’ list. For
this the correction window shall be available at PM-Kisan portal for
authorized users of District and Block officials.
(c)
If States / UTs want to make fresh entry of a farmer, provision is there for
registration of these farmers in a defined and standardized format.

9.6
Records preparation process through PM-KISAN Portal:
1. State-admin and District-admin need to be identified for creation of login
credentials or approval of login credentials in case of self-registration by
District and Block / Tehsil / Taluka officials.

10
2. Farmers list as available on the portal shall be available at Block / Tehsil /
Taluka level official’s login.
3. Search facility will also be available to get details on Farmers by Name,
Aadhaar Number or Mobile Number in case PM-KISAN Portal data is being
used. Facility to add new farmers’ details shall be available, if details are not
found in the list.
4. The verified list shall be e-signed by the District level or block / tehsil / taluka
level officials as the case may be. The exclusion categories specified in
scheme guidelines also need to be taken care before e-signing the verified
farmers list.
5. The States Nodal Officer shall submit a district wise e-Signed list of farmers to
the Program Division of DAC&FW through PM-Kisan Portal.

Modalities for transfer of benefit
10.1 The financial benefit of Rs.6000/- per year is to be released to the eligible
farmers in three installments of Rs.2000/- each every 4-month / trimester, i.e. April-July,
August-November and December-Ma

August-November and December-March.
10.2 The Scheme is being implemented through an Aadhaar linked electronic data
base containing details of all members of the families of the farmers whose names

pertaining to the trimester December, 2019 – March, 2020 onwards shall be done only

and Aadhaar seeded database under the scheme till 31.3.2021. In the meantime these
States will complete Aadhaar enrolment so that subsequent installments are released

shall be released from Government of India to the State designated account /

(a)
The amount due to the beneficiaries under the scheme is to be paid directly into
their bank accounts through the mechanism of Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). The

during the year.

1. OBJECTIVE OF THE SCHEME
The Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students (PM-USP CSSS) is implemented by the Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Government of India. The objective of the scheme is to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher education after senior secondary (Class 12).
2. ALLOCATION AND QUANTUM OF SCHOLARSHIPS
A total of 82,000 new scholarships are awarded every year across India. The scholarships are divided equally between boys (41,000) and girls (41,000). The scholarships are distributed among the State Education Boards based on the population in the age

The scholarships are divided equally between boys (41,000) and girls (41,000). The scholarships are distributed among the State Education Boards based on the population in the age group of 18-25 years in the respective State.
3. RATE OF SCHOLARSHIP AND FINANCIAL BENEFITS
Under the PM-USP CSSS scheme, financial assistance is paid directly to eligible students via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) into their Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts:
- At Graduation Level (Undergraduate): Rs. 12,000 per annum for the first three years of degree courses (Years 1, 2, and 3).
- At Post-Graduation Level: Rs. 20,000 per annum for 2 years of postgraduate studies (e.g., M.A., M.Sc., M.Com.).
- For 5-Year Integrated / Professional Courses (like B.Tech, Integrated M.Sc): Rs. 12,000 per annum is paid for the 1st, 2nd, and 3rd year, and Rs. 20,000 per annum is paid for the 4th and 5th year.

4. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
To be eligible for the PM-USP CSSS scholarship, an applicant must satisfy the following conditions:
(a) Merit Requirement: The student must have scored above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream (Science, Commerce, Humanities) from the respective Board of Examination in Class 12 (10+2 pattern).
(b) Enrollment: The student must be enrolled in a regular, full-time degree course in a recognized College, Institution, or University recognized by UGC, AICTE, MCI, or DCI. Correspondence, open university, and distance education courses are strictly ineligible.
(c) Family Income Ceiling: The gross annual family/parental income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 4,50,000 (Rs. 4.5 Lakh) per

tance education courses are strictly ineligible.
(c) Family Income Ceiling: The gross annual family/parental income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 4,50,000 (Rs. 4.5 Lakh) per annum. A valid income certificate issued by a competent revenue authority is mandatory.
(d) Exclusivity: The student must not be receiving any other scholarship, fellowship, or fee concession/reimbursement from the Central Government or State Government.
(e) Reservation: Reservation quotas apply as per Government of India norms (15% for SC, 7.5% for ST, 27% for OBC-NCL, and 5% horizontal reservation for Persons with Disabilities).
5. RENEWAL OF SCHOLARSHIP
Scholarships are renewed on an annual basis up to the completion of the degree:
- The scholar must secure at least 50% marks in the annual university/college examination.
- The scholar must maintain at least 75% attendance in the institution.
- Any change in

:
- The scholar must secure at least 50% marks in the annual university/college examination.
- The scholar must maintain at least 75% attendance in the institution.
- Any change in the course of study or college without prior approval shall lead to forfeiture of scholarship.
6. HOW TO APPLY AND REQUIRED DOCUMENTS
Applications must be submitted online exclusively through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at https://scholarships.gov.in/.
Mandatory documents include:
- Aadhaar Card and Aadhaar-seeded active bank account passbook
- Class 12 Board Examination Marksheet and Passing Certificate
- Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (income <= Rs. 4.5 Lakh)
- Bonafide student admission certificate from the enrolled college/university
- Caste / Disability certificate (if applicable)

AICTE - SWANATH SCHOLARSHIP SCHEME (TECHNICAL DEGREE AND DIPLOMA)

(a) Orphan children;
(b) Children whose parents died due to Covid-19 pandemic;
(c) Wards of Armed Forces and Central Paramilitary Forces (CAPF) personnel martyred in action (Shaheed).
The assistance encourages such meritorious youth to pursue technical education in approved professional institutions.

Under the AICTE Swanath Scholarship Scheme:
- Financial assistance of Rs. 50,000 per annum (fifty thousand rupees per year) is paid as a lump sum amount for every year of regular study.
- The scholarship covers college tuition fees, purchase of laptops/computers, books, stationeries, equipment, and specialized technical software.
- Duration of Scholarship:
* For Technical Degree: Up to a maximum of 4 years for students admitted to the first year (and up to 3 years for diploma holders admitted via lateral entry to 2nd year).
* For Technical Diploma: Up to a maximum of 3 years for students admitted to the first year (and up to 2 years for lateral entry).
- Payment Mode: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via Public Financial Management System (PFMS).

3. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
To be eligible for the AICTE Swanath Scholarship, an applicant must satisfy all of the following conditions:
(a) Qualifying Category (Must satisfy at least one):

- Child whose both parents died due to Covid-19; OR
- Ward of Armed Forces or Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) personnel martyred in action.
(b) Educational Enrollment: The student must be admitted to the 1st year (or 2nd year lateral entry) of an AICTE-approved technical Degree or Diploma program in an AICTE-approved institution.

Applications are invited annually through the National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at https://scholarships.gov.in/ under the AICTE Schemes tab. Applications are verified electronically at the Institute level and then by AICTE Nodal Officers before sanction.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
Category: Agriculture | Ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Rs. 6,000 per year paid in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 directly into the bank accounts of eligible farmer families through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
Key Benefits:
- Direct financial support of Rs. 6,000 annually per beneficiary family
- Paid in 3 equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months
- Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) credited directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts
- Helps meet farm input expenses and domestic necessities ahead of harvest seasons
Eligibility Criteria Summary: All landholding farmer families having cultivable land in their names, subject to statutory exclusion criteria (such as income tax payers and institutional landholders).
Exclusions:
- All institutional landholders
- Farmer families in which one or more members belong to: Former and present holders of constitutional posts
- Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors of Municipal Corporations, and Chairpersons of District Panchayats
- Serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries, Departments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), Autonomous bodies, Local bodies (excluding Multi Tasking Staff / Class IV / Group D employees)
- All superannuated / retired pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding Class IV / Group D pensioners)
- All persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year
- Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out profession
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card (mandatory)
- Landholding document / Record of Rights (ROR) / Khasra Khatauni
- Aadhaar-seeded active bank account passbook details
- Active mobile number linked with Aadhaar
- Citizenship proof and self-declaration of landholding
How to Apply: Eligible farmers can apply online through the PM-KISAN portal (Farmers Corner > New Farmer Registration) or via local Common Service Centres (CSCs) and State Nodal Officers.

Scheme Name: PM-USP - Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
Category: Education | Ministry: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education)
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Rs. 12,000 per annum at graduation level for the first 3 years of college, and Rs. 20,000 per annum at postgraduate level (or in 4th and 5th year for professional courses).
Key Benefits:
- Scholarship of Rs. 12,000 per annum for undergraduate degree years (Years 1 to 3)
- Scholarship of Rs. 20,000 per annum for postgraduate studies or 4th/5th year of 5-year integrated professional courses
- Total 82,000 new scholarships awarded annually (divided equally: 41,000 for boys and 41,000 for girls)
- Direct DBT transfer into student's verified bank account via National Scholarship Portal
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Students scoring above 80th percentile in relevant stream in Class 12 board examination, pursuing regular degree course in recognized institution, with annual family income up to Rs. 4.5 Lakh.
Exclusions:
- Students pursuing studies through correspondence, distance, or open university mode
- Students receiving any other scholarship or fee reimbursement from Central or State Government
- Students whose annual family gross income exceeds Rs. 4.5 Lakh
- Students who failed in any academic year or do not maintain minimum 50% marks in annual university exams for renewal
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card
- Class 12 Passing Certificate and Marksheet
- Valid Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (income <= Rs. 4.5 Lakh)
- Proof of admission / Bonafide student certificate from recognized college/university
- Student bank account passbook (Aadhaar seeded)
- Caste / Disability certificate (if claiming reservation quota)
How to Apply: Applications must be submitted online on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) under the Central Sector Schemes section.

Scheme Name: AICTE - Swanath Scholarship Scheme (Technical Degree & Diploma)
Category: Education | Ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE), Ministry of Education
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Rs. 50,000 per annum lump sum amount paid for every year of study towards college fee, computers, books, equipment, and software.
Key Benefits:
- Rs. 50,000 per annum fixed assistance for every year of regular study
- Awarded for maximum 4 years for Degree students, and 3 years for Diploma students
- Covers tuition fees, hostel expenses, books, equipment, and laptops
- Credited directly via PFMS DBT into beneficiary student's bank account
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Orphan students, or Covid-19 orphaned children, or children of martyred Armed/Paramilitary Forces personnel; enrolled in 1st year (or lateral entry 2nd year) in an AICTE-approved technical institution; family income not exceeding Rs. 8 Lakh per annum.
Exclusions:
- Students enrolled in non-AICTE approved institutions or non-technical general degree programs
- Students admitted through management quota or non-merit process
- Family income from all sources exceeding Rs. 8,00,000 per annum
- Students availing duplicate benefits under similar Central/State scholarship schemes
Documents Required:
- Death certificate of parents (for orphans or COVID-19 deceased parents)
- Martyrdom certificate issued by Defence or Paramilitary authority
- Family Income Certificate issued by competent authority (income <= Rs. 8 Lakh)
- Admission letter / Bonafide certificate from AICTE-approved institution
- Class 10 and Class 12 / Diploma mark sheets
- Aadhaar Card and Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar
How to Apply: Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) during the active application cycle and get the application verified by the institute's nodal officer.

Scheme Name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
Category: Health | Ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Health cover of Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year on a family floater basis for secondary and tertiary care hospitalisation.
Key Benefits:
- Cashless treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals
- Cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year
- Covers pre- and post-hospitalisation expenses as per scheme rules
- No cap on family size, age or gender
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Families identified as deprived / vulnerable under SECC 2011 criteria for rural and urban areas, and other categories notified by States/UTs.
Exclusions:
- Families not identified under the notified SECC / State beneficiary list
- Treatment at non-empanelled hospitals is not covered under the scheme
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card
- Ration Card / Family ID as applicable
- Proof of residence and identity of family members
- PM-JAY beneficiary card / e-card if already issued
How to Apply: Check eligibility on the beneficiary portal or at a Common Service Centre / empanelled hospital help desk, then complete e-KYC to get the Ayushman card.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin
Category: Housing | Ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Rs. 1,20,000 in plain areas and Rs. 1,30,000 in hilly / difficult areas, released in instalments directly to the beneficiary.
Key Benefits:
- Assistance for construction of a pucca house
- Toilet support through convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission - Gramin
- Unskilled wage support through convergence with MGNREGA
- Support for LPG connection through convergence with PM Ujjwala Yojana
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Rural households that are houseless or living in kutcha / dilapidated houses and identified through SECC 2011 and Awaas+ survey, subject to exclusion criteria.
Exclusions:
- Households owning a pucca house or a motorised vehicle / mechanised agricultural equipment as per exclusion criteria
- Households with a government employee member or an income-tax payer member, as per scheme exclusion rules
- Households not in the Permanent Waitlist / Awaas+ list
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card
- MGNREGA Job Card if available
- Bank account details
- Affidavit / self-declaration as required by the Gram Panchayat
- Swachh Bharat Mission details for toilet construction
How to Apply: Eligible households are identified through the Permanent Waitlist. Check status on pmayg.nic.in or contact the Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana
Category: Financial Inclusion | Ministry: Ministry of Finance
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Zero-balance bank account with RuPay debit card and overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000 for eligible account holders after satisfactory operation.
Key Benefits:
- Bank account with no minimum balance requirement
- RuPay debit card with in-built accident insurance as per scheme rules
- Direct Benefit Transfer of subsidies into the account
- Overdraft up to Rs. 10,000 for eligible accounts, with preference to the woman account holder of the household
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Any Indian citizen, with account opening for minors above 10 years of age, who does not already have a bank account. Any individual can open an account.
Exclusions:
- Persons already holding a regular bank account are not the primary target, though conversion rules apply as per bank guidelines
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card
- PAN Card or Form 60 if available
- Passport-size photograph
- Proof of address if Aadhaar address differs
How to Apply: Apply at any bank branch or Bank Mitra outlet with Aadhaar and photograph, or through the bank's account opening form.

Scheme Name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
Category: Savings | Ministry: Ministry of Finance
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Deposit Rs. 250 to Rs. 1,50,000 per financial year. The account matures after 21 years from opening or on marriage of the girl child after age 18, as per rules.
Key Benefits:
- High interest rate notified by the Government for the scheme, compounded yearly
- Deposits qualify for tax deduction as notified under the Income Tax Act
- Partial withdrawal up to 50% of balance for higher education of the girl child after age 18
- Account can be opened at post offices and authorised bank branches
Eligibility Criteria Summary: A girl child below 10 years of age. Only one account per girl child, and a maximum of two accounts per family except in case of twin / triplet girl children.
Exclusions:
- Girl child above 10 years of age at the time of opening, except as allowed in special cases notified by the Government
- More than one account for the same girl child
- More than two accounts per family except for twin / triplet girls
Documents Required:
- Birth certificate of the girl child
- Aadhaar and PAN / identity proof of parent or guardian
- Address proof of parent or guardian
- Passport-size photographs
- KYC form of the post office / bank
How to Apply: Open the account at a post office or authorised bank branch with the girl child's birth certificate and guardian's KYC documents.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
Category: Business | Ministry: Ministry of Finance
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Shishu: up to Rs. 50,000. Kishore: above Rs. 50,000 up to Rs. 5 lakh. Tarun: above Rs. 5 lakh up to Rs. 10 lakh. Tarun Plus: above Rs. 10 lakh up to Rs. 20 lakh for successful Tarun borrowers.
Key Benefits:
- Collateral-free loans as per bank / MFI lending norms
- Loans for working capital and term needs of micro enterprises
- MUDRA Card facility for working capital as per bank rules
- Interest subvention / support where notified by the Government
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Indian citizens with a viable business plan for a non-farm micro / small enterprise, including proprietors, partnership firms, SHG members and small companies as per lender norms.
Exclusions:
- Applicants who are defaulters of any bank / financial institution
- Businesses that do not meet the lender's viability and KYC norms
- Large corporate enterprises outside the micro / small enterprise definition
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card and PAN Card
- Proof of business address and business plan / project report
- Bank statements for the previous period as required by the lender
- Proof of category / licence / registration if applicable
- Quotation of items to be purchased, if applicable
How to Apply: Apply at any bank, NBFC or microfinance institution with a business plan, or through the Udyamimitra portal / JanSamarth portal.

Scheme Name: Atal Pension Yojana
Category: Pension | Ministry: Ministry of Finance
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Guaranteed pension of Rs. 1,000, Rs. 2,000, Rs. 3,000, Rs. 4,000 or Rs. 5,000 per month after age 60, depending on the chosen pension slab and contributions.
Key Benefits:
- Guaranteed minimum pension after age 60
- Spouse continues to receive the same pension after the subscriber's death
- Nominee receives the accumulated pension wealth on death of both subscriber and spouse
- Auto-debit of contributions from the linked savings bank account
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years with a savings bank account or post office savings account. Income-tax payers from 1 October 2022 are not eligible to newly enrol.
Exclusions:
- Persons below 18 years or above 40 years of age
- Persons without a savings bank / post office savings account
- Income-tax payers enrolling on or after 1 October 2022
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card
- Savings bank account / post office savings account details
- Mobile number linked to the account
- Nominee details
How to Apply: Enrol at a bank branch or through net banking by filling the APY registration form and choosing a pension slab.

Scheme Name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme
Category: Skill | Ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Collateral-free enterprise loans in two tranches: Rs. 1 lakh first, then Rs. 2 lakh, at a concessional interest rate of 5% per annum, plus toolkit incentive and training stipend as per scheme rules.
Key Benefits:
- Recognition as a Vishwakarma with ID card and certificate
- Basic and advanced skill training with stipend
- Toolkit incentive of Rs. 15,000
- Credit support, digital transaction incentive and marketing support
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Artisan or craftsperson aged 18 years or above, working in one of the 18 notified traditional trades in the unorganised sector on a self-employment basis, and not having taken loans under PMEGP / PM SVANidhi / Mudra in the last 5 years as per scheme rules.
Exclusions:
- Persons below 18 years of age
- Government employees and their family members
- Persons who have availed PMEGP, PM SVANidhi or Mudra loans in the last 5 years, as per scheme rules
- Trades not in the notified list of 18 trades
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card
- Mobile number linked with Aadhaar
- Bank account details
- Ration Card if available
- Proof of occupation / trade
How to Apply: Enrol free of charge at a Common Service Centre with Aadhaar, followed by verification by the Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
Category: Insurance | Ministry: Ministry of Finance
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Life cover of Rs. 2,00,000 on death of the subscriber, for an annual premium of Rs. 436, auto-debited from the bank account.
Key Benefits:
- Rs. 2 lakh life insurance cover
- Low annual premium of Rs. 436
- Renewable every year
- Cover available through the subscriber's bank account
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Individual bank / post office account holders aged 18 to 50 years, with consent for auto-debit of premium. Cover continues up to age 55 on renewal as per scheme rules.
Exclusions:
- Persons below 18 years or above 50 years at enrolment
- Persons without an individual bank / post office account
- Multiple accounts of the same person are not eligible for duplicate cover
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card
- Bank account details
- Consent-cum-declaration form for auto-debit
- Nominee details
How to Apply: Apply at the bank branch holding your account, or through net banking / mobile banking, by submitting the consent form before 31 May for the cover year.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
Category: Insurance | Ministry: Ministry of Finance
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Rs. 2,00,000 for accidental death or total irrecoverable disability, and Rs. 1,00,000 for partial disability, for an annual premium of Rs. 20.
Key Benefits:
- Accident death and disability cover
- Very low annual premium of Rs. 20
- Renewable every year up to age 70
- Auto-debit from the bank account
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Individual bank / post office account holders aged 18 to 70 years, with consent for auto-debit of premium.
Exclusions:
- Persons below 18 years or above 70 years of age
- Persons without an individual bank / post office account
- Duplicate cover through multiple accounts of the same person
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card
- Bank account details
- Consent-cum-declaration form for auto-debit
- Nominee details
How to Apply: Apply at the bank branch holding your account, or through net banking / mobile banking, by submitting the consent form.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
Category: Energy | Ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
Financial Assistance / Scholarship Amount: Deposit-free LPG connection with EMI facility for the stove and first refill as per scheme rules, and targeted subsidy as notified by the Government.
Key Benefits:
- Deposit-free LPG connection in the name of an adult woman
- EMI option for stove and refill cost
- Targeted subsidy on LPG refills as notified
- Health benefit from smoke-free cooking
Eligibility Criteria Summary: Adult woman aged 18 years or above from a household without an existing LPG connection, belonging to SECC 2011 list, SC/ST, PMAY-G, Antyodaya, forest dwellers, island / river island residents, tea garden workers, or other categories notified, including households left out in Ujjwala 2.0 on self-declaration.
Exclusions:
- Households that already have an LPG connection in the name of any member
- Applicants below 18 years of age
- Male applicants, as the connection is issued in the name of an adult woman of the household
Documents Required:
- Aadhaar Card of the applicant and adult family members
- State-issued ration card or family ID
- Address proof
- Bank account details
- Self-declaration for Ujjwala 2.0 applicants where applicable
- Passport-size photograph
How to Apply: Apply online on pmuy.gov.in or at an LPG distributor with the KYC form, or through a Common Service Centre.
